```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

root = Path.cwd()
while not (root / '.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root == root.parent: raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root = root.parent
out = root / 'assets/img/generated/patrons-espacials.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans', 'font.size':14,
                     'svg.fonttype':'none', 'figure.facecolor':'white'})
patterns = [np.array([[10,30],[10,30]]), np.array([[10,30],[30,10]])]
assert all(p.mean() == 20 for p in patterns)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(7.4,3.5),layout='constrained')
for ax, values, title in zip(axes, patterns, ['Agrupació', 'Alternança']):
    for y in range(2):
        for x in range(2):
            value = values[y,x]
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x,y),1,1,facecolor='#d5e2ef' if value==10 else '#003366',
                                   edgecolor='white',lw=3))
            ax.text(x+.5,y+.5,str(value),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=22,
                    color='#003366' if value==10 else 'white')
    ax.set(xlim=(0,2),ylim=(0,2),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],title=title,
           xlabel='4 àrees · mitjana = 20')
    for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False)
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
